title: GreenDrive
description: An eco-friendly routing engine that computes fuel-optimal driving paths using real-time elevation changes, stoplight frequencies, and edge regression models.

title: GhostScanner
description: A concurrent Go-based scanner designed to identify and safely exploit complex HTTP Request Smuggling (CL.TE and TE.CL) vulnerabilities on edge proxy networks.

title: Linux Kernel Process Sandbox
description: A custom kernel-level security module implementing lightweight sandboxing, syscall auditing, and chroot-like filesystem isolation.

title: MiniCPU & Assembler
description: A complete 16-bit virtual CPU simulator with registers, custom instruction set architecture (ISA), assembler compiler, and memory-mapped graphics screen.
